lines.name: NATSO
lines.subject: lou
lines.text: Eight o'clock. Don't make me ask twice.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: On your desk by eight, Lou.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Days are his. Saturdays are mine.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Two thousand in savings. A paycheck every Friday. Biscayne on weekends.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Slick: "Smart. A paycheck buys you time to learn. Never play above your roll."
